messages:
elaine-cs: Quick heads-up: Meridian private VPC cutover showed intermittent failures for audit log delivery to our intake. Flagging watch until we validate logs and connectivity. :mag:
samir-net: flow logs show SYN retries from 10.72.2.0/24 -> our ingress ENI during the 02:10 UTC window. No SG denies. Running MTU probe + traceroute now.
jess-sec: checked IAM/KMS: role meridian-log-writer exists but KMS alias/redwood/meridian-logs lacks a grant for their external principal. Will open grant request and draft customer consent language for presigned S3 fallback.
noah-sre: repro from their bastion at ~02:25 UTC:
```
curl -s -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" https://inference.internal/health || echo FAIL
# intermittent 000s, tcp retransmits visible
```
Captured pcap and uploaded to ticket. Suspect MTU mismatch.
elaine-cs: renewal check-in in 4 days, need artifacts for the deck. Owners: samir -> temp route & MTU test; jess -> KMS grant + consent; noah -> pcap + final smoke. Post one-line updates when done.
samir-net: applied temp route at 09:00 PT, TTL 90m. Initial: retransmits dropped from ~20% -> ~3%. Monitoring.
jess-sec: INFRA-9710 submitted for cross-account grant (owner=jess-sec). Drafted presigned S3 consent and sent to customer for signature.
noah-sre: ran final smoke at 11:20 PT: 15m window clear, p99 within SLA. Uploaded graphs and pcap to INFRA-9710.
elaine-cs: moving account from "at-risk" -> "watch" pending signed consent or grant. I'll assemble renewal update with attachments. Thanks team.
